![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

Add defensive guards when mapping `prior_validators` in `renderReadback` to handle nullish or malformed elements gracefully, preventing potential `TypeError` exceptions.

```suggestion
"- Prior validators compared: " + (Array.isArray(thresholdsArtifact.upstream_comparison?.prior_validators) ? thresholdsArtifact.upstream_comparison.prior_validators.filter((item) => item && typeof item === 'object').map((item) => (item.role ?? 'unknown') + '=' + (item.status ?? 'unknown')).join(', ') : '')
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. Ensure readback or report generation functions are null-safe and use defensive guards, optional chaining, and safe default objects when dereferencing properties from potentially missing or malformed input artifacts, allowing the script to fail-closed gracefully instead of throwing a TypeError.
</details>
Fixed in 592c468c0: `buildValidatorResult` now filters malformed policy entries before mapping predicates or finding the high-risk entry, with focused malformed-policy coverage.
Fixed in 592c468c0: `renderReadback` now guards `prior_validators` before mapping and formats only object entries; the focused test covers malformed prior-validator rows.
Fixed in 592c468c0: `countBy` now skips nullish and non-object entries before invoking an accessor or reading a property, with regression coverage for malformed elements.

Fixed in 592c468c0: `buildMeasuredCalibration` now filters malformed assertions and evidence refs before flattening, counting, or dereferencing them; the focused test covers malformed assertions and refs.
Fixed in 592c468c0: `sha256File` now wraps `readFileSync` hashing in `try/catch` and returns `null` on read errors so artifact hashing fails closed.
